applications.name: Google Analytics
applications.description:
**App overview:**

The Google Analytics app helps you understand your store visitors’ behavior through accurate, detailed data, such as:

- The number of visitors and visits during a specific time period
- The age group and gender of your store visitors
- The devices and browsers used to access your store
- Traffic sources (search engines, social media, ads, and more)

**How to connect:**

To learn how to activate the app and link it to your store, **[click here.](https://help.zid.sa/google-analytics/)**
applications.short_description: A service that enables you to collect and analyze data from your store easily and smoothly
